device.inAppBody: This link opened inside {{app}}. The camera and My Uploads work better in {{browser}}.

inAppSteps.ios: Tap ••• in the corner of the screen, then choose Open in Safari or Open in external browser.
inAppSteps.other: Tap ••• in the corner of the screen, then choose Open in browser.

device.copyFailed: The link could not be copied. Open the ••• menu and choose a browser.
device.cameraHelpBody: Your phone may be blocking the camera for this site. Follow these steps, then try again.

cameraSteps.ios: Open Settings, choose Safari, then Camera, and choose Allow.
cameraSteps.chrome: Tap the icon to the left of the site address, choose Permissions, then allow Camera.
cameraSteps.samsung: Open your phone's Settings, choose Apps, Samsung Internet, Permissions, then allow Camera.

device.useGalleryHint: Use {{upload}} to send photos from your phone's gallery.
